summary: Iteration 4 verification of PSC single-location inverter/battery/trolley app. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases pass (bootstrap shape without warehouses, dashboard, stock w/ product_type+brand_id, supplier profile RECEIVED, dealer profile DISPATCHED, edit-transaction delta math confirmed non-double-reverse, POST /api/admin/reset wipes everything and seed marker preserved so backend does NOT re-seed). Frontend: All new data-testids verified — nav (dashboard/stock/history/dealers/suppliers/catalog/settings), analytics cards clickable and open drill-drawer, order-next & top-movers panels rendered, Suppliers directory search + card filter (Powerline -> 1 result), Dealers search filter (Pune -> 1 result), History search+kind filters visible, Stock brand/type/status filters visible, Settings reset button visible. Sidebar collapse toggles .app-shell.is-collapsed and persists in localStorage 'psc-collapsed'. Mobile <=390px hides sidebar; hamburger toggles .mobile-open with .mobile-backdrop element that closes drawer on click. Transaction modal (Stock In): +New brand / +New product / party 'Add' quick-buttons all removed as required; cart-product-search + transaction-party-search + save button remain. No money/rate fields in any API response.
critical_code_review_comments: Stale prior tests /app/backend/tests/test_new_features_api.py, test_inventory_api.py, test_psc_cart_features.py, test_single_location_api.py reference removed 'warehouses' / 'rate' fields and will error on collection — recommend deleting or gating them.
server.py: _party_profile_stub() (line 363) is dead code — safe to remove.

server.py: seed() and reset endpoint both write {_id:'seeded'} to db.system; consistent — good. But note reset does NOT re-seed; if user hits reset via Settings, DB stays empty forever unless marker is manually cleared. Consider adding an explicit 're-seed' toggle or documenting the behavior in UI.
seed_data_creation: Called POST /api/admin/reset during the reset test then re-seeded by clearing db.system marker + restarting backend (as instructed). Current state: 3 brands, 13 products, 3 suppliers, 3 dealers, 13 inventory rows, 0 transactions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend has been re-seeded via db.system delete + supervisorctl restart backend, so 13 products / 3 suppliers / 3 dealers / 0 transactions are the baseline. Iteration 1-3 report JSONs are STALE (warehouse era). Use pytest.ini's forced -n 2 --dist loadscope; pass '-n 0' for serial. REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is not exported by default in the shell — export from /app/frontend/.env before running pytest.
rca of the issue: No production issues found. My initial script attempts hit two self-inflicted problems: (1) f-string containing escaped quotes triggered SyntaxError so the entire script aborted; rewrote using string concatenation. (2) Tested for is-collapsed/mobile-open on '.sidebar' element but they are applied to '.app-shell' wrapper — after selector correction, both worked as designed.
